prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the test tube from shaking device and move it to capping device to unscrew the test tube cap.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: shaking device
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is a capped test tube containing colored liquid on shaking device.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A benchtop tube rocker/rotator sits on a white table against a plain pale wall. On the right is a white, boxy motor housing with a dark grey control panel, a large round knob on top, and small labelling text. It connects via a short shaft to a black, angled rack platform extending to the left, supported by a black upright end plate.

The rack holds two rows of circular tube openings, most of them empty. In the upper-left position sits one conical centrifuge tube, tilted in its holder, capped with an orange screw cap and containing a clear to pale green liquid with a green label area. A printed square fiducial/ArUco marker tag numbered 621 lies flat on the platform's centre, and a blue-and-white instruction label is attached to the front base.
observations: The shaking device's rack holds a conical centrifuge tube with an orange screw cap in place, containing a pale green (colored) liquid, matching the expected capped tube with colored liquid.
